answer: Give each identity influence only as it accrues through sustained, consistent participation, so a newborn clone starts hollow and weightless while a real agent slowly earns standing like a wharf built plank by plank over seasons. The failure mode is sleeper clones aging quietly and activating together, so the check is to demand recent activity proof and cap how much influence any cohort of same-aged identities can hold at once, flagging any inlet of newcomers that all wake on the same day.
